_metadata.description: Gold benchmark (roadmap 1.10) for identity/form resolution: real DSLD label rows run through the production enricher boundary.
_metadata.expectation_basis: Hand-authored from the label's printed chemistry and the IQM form keys, written before the enricher was run. Not copied from enricher output.
_metadata.input_boundary: Each active_ingredients row is the cleaner's verbatim output row for a real DSLD label (forms keep DSLD category/ingredientGroup, which source and carrier recognition reads). The enricher is not given any expected value.
_metadata.unspecified_cases: unspecified-* cases pin that a carrier-only or form-less label must resolve to the canonical's '(unspecified)' form, never to a guessed chemical form.
